role: independent acceptance package for A7 - test and fixture only, no implementation changes

contracts_to_satisfy.fixed_corpus: every query has a fixed set of expected relevant pages
contracts_to_satisfy.comparison: pure-lexical vs hybrid results can be compared
contracts_to_satisfy.traceability: each report keeps query, filters, candidates and final ranking
contracts_to_satisfy.reproducibility: same code + corpus + index state yields the same report

deliverables: fixed queries with labelled relevant pages
task-local ledger, L3 record, progress log and handoff

positive: fixed queries can be executed repeatedly
lexical vs hybrid differences are recorded
index or model change triggers a regression report
honesty: the report explicitly separates verified items, unverified items and follow-up tasks
the RecallAuditRecord subset chain must NOT be presented as recall-quality evidence - it only proves the audit record is self-consistent

forbidden_claims: claiming real-domain paper quality from fixture results
inferring content truth from ranking changes
skipping failed, missed or degraded results
